hooks.command:
jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Apply the writing-style skill below to all human-readable text you write this session (documentation, comments, commit messages, PR descriptions, emails, changelogs, etc). It is loaded automatically for every session, not only on request.

" + .)}}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/writing-style/SKILL.md" 2>/dev/null || true

jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Apply the source-file-header skill below whenever creating a new source file (shell, Dockerfile, PHP, INI, template, etc). It is loaded automatically for every session, not only on request.

" + .)}}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/source-file-header/SKILL.md" 2>/dev/null || true
